state_owned.name: external-controller-run-directory
state_owned.summary: Frozen inputs, ledger, attempts, process identity, structured results, and diagnostics remain outside worker-writable scope.

invariants.statement: Workers report claims and may edit authorized paths; they cannot grant permissions, commit authority, ledger ownership, or semantic acceptance.
Missing output, process failure, timeout, or ambiguous liveness does not authorize completion or another writer.
Safe public recovery, full semantic review/correction, finalization and automatic advancement remain unimplemented; planned interfaces are not current contracts.
